title: Open-frame single-seat race car in a workshop
visual_facts: An open tubular metal frame chassis with a single black racing seat occupies the center foreground.
The vehicle has wide black tires, exposed suspension and other mechanical parts, and a light blue block covering the front.
Two wide monitors are mounted behind the vehicle, with a computer interface visible on the left screen.
A bright red multi-drawer tool chest stands at the right; boxes and workshop items line the left side.
A shop vacuum and stools are positioned around the vehicle.
spatial_relations: The vehicle is centered in front of the monitor workstation.
The red tool chest is at the rear right of the vehicle.
A shop vacuum and stools stand near the vehicle on the right.
uncertainties: The exact vehicle model and the purpose of the front blue covering are not identifiable from this view.
